items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: So the next thing I knew, Jack had his coat and hat and was leaving... Anyway, that was the first and last lesson that I had from Jack Smith.

ctx.x: to him, too. But my father decided that he would have Jack give me some piano lessons.

So when he told me about it, he said, "Mr. Smith is going to come by and give you some piano lessons, and he says he'll be by on Tuesday" or something. I could hardly wait, because this guy...to come and push this magic button and make me a pianist. But when he came in, I was sitting at the piano, I had been sitting at the piano for the last hour... He came in and he listened to a few little things I did, and then he sat down and played a couple of pieces. I was admiring him, and he said, "Oh, you liked that?" I…
